title: 1inch TWAP
tagline: Decentralized TWAP protocol built on top of 1inch limit order book
description:
This project uses 1inch limit order SDK, limit order protocol and a TWAP contract that is called in the Aggregator contract predicate to regulate fill order calls. 
The UI is built using nextjs, typescript, shadcn and other web3 libraries like wagmi, ethers etc.
